en.title: Play the Snow Temple yard duel through to the result
en.body: The Android example and its browser reference can play the entire encounter with one swordsman, including retaliation, damage to Lin Chong, victory, defeat and restart.

zh.title: 草料场首战支持连续交战、胜负与重开
zh.body: Android 示例与浏览器对照页可以和同一名刀手打完整场交战，支持刀手还击、林冲受伤、胜负结算和场内重开。
